reviews.title: Automatic translation
reviews.text: Every time I open a recipe, the app prompts me with a popup asking if I want to translate it. Having to dismiss this prompt repeatedly interrupts the experience. Please add a toggle in the settings menu (e.g., "Always show original" or "Do not ask to translate") to disable this prompt permanently.

reviews.title: Can’t find recipes
reviews.text: It has hard time finding a recipes - for example “apple pie” - will find only one recipe but will show recipes for different cakes. It’s a paid app and i would expect something better .

reviews.title: You can’t filter or see reviews!
reviews.text: It’s weird that you can’t leave reviews for other users to see. It would be great for the Thermomix community to see each other’s notes. You can’t filter the collections by language! Many recipes are repetitive.

reviews.title: Can’t connect
reviews.text: It shows that I am logged in with my email in my Thermomix and the app but recepies are not connected.

reviews.title: App not synced with website
reviews.text:
For the price paid for the thermomix and the cookidoo subscription, I was hoping that there would not have bugs on it.

I just want to bookmark recipes from the website connected with my account (which is way more easy than on the phone) and it’s just not sync neither with the phone app nor the thermomix.

Really disappointing

reviews.title: 4G/5G Connectivity and Sync Failure
reviews.text: The Cookidoo iOS app does not work when connected via 4G or 5G and is only accessible over Wi-Fi. In addition, data does not synchronize properly between the app and the Thermomix. These recurring connectivity and synchronization issues significantly affect the user experience and need to be fixed.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: It’s 2026 how is this they there is no AI based search, no concepts like pantry management and find recipes I can cook or generate a meal plan for me around some basic proteins you have on hand

reviews.title: Not a tech company
reviews.text: The machine works great, I have consistently been amazed by it… The interface leaves a lot to be desired. Your profile should be able to mark your dietary needs so that only those recipes come up, such as vegetarian or vegan or gluten-free. And your country or region having to match on your profile and your Thermo mix for them to sink… I want to be able to switch so that different recipes come up from different areas… and I can’t always multiply the recipe the way that I want to, so it should be easy to always change the recipe serving size and automatically change the recipe. The search function just really isn’t the best. And not being able to access other user created recipes is quite frustrating it depends on which region you’re in.

reviews.title: Bypasses notification restrictions
reviews.text: I have all notifications turned off for Cookidoo but it still gives a sound notifications even when my phone an Apple watch are in a strict Do Not Disturb mode with no notifications allowed whatsoever. Additionally it gives an alert on my Apple watch even though I removed the app from my watch.

reviews.title: Can’t log in to app
reviews.text: The app is useless. I can log in on the website to look up and save recipes but the app doesn’t let me log in, saying my credentials are incorrect. No customer service, no help. Useless.

reviews.title: Stay away
reviews.text: Stay away from this product. Seriously 1k for this appliance and have to pay a subscription fee for the app recipes to use this thing outside of manual mode? Do yourself a favor and ignore the whole product and app all together you’ll save a lot of money.

reviews.title: Complete scam company
reviews.text: Do not buy this expensive product you will be sadly disappointed, especially if you live in France and don’t speak French. Please know that if your language does not match your billing address you’re gonna be very upset and unable to use something you paid almost $2000 for the customer service is appalling they don’t care anything about you once they have your money
